name: Do Not Sell My Books at My Funeral
title: Unisex Bookish – Do Not Sell My Books at My Funeral Socks
story: Do Not Sell My Books at My Funeral: bookish socks for the reader who has already left instructions about the shelves, a stocking stuffer for the book club friend, the librarian or the sister whose to-be-read pile has its own bookcase, wrapped for Christmas.

The print is an engraved stack of old books tied with a big ribbon bow, lilies and a sprig of rosemary resting on top and a lit candle burning beside it, with DO NOT SELL MY BOOKS above and AT MY FUNERAL. below in heavy burgundy slab letters, all on a cream ground. The art matches our Do Not Sell My Books crewneck and Do Not Sell My Books hoodie, so the socks make a set with either one.

Every serious reader has pictured the estate sale where a stranger gets the first editions for a dollar, and has made the last wish out loud: not the books. The line reads from across the room, on a couch with a paperback in your hands or propped on an ottoman at book club. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the person who already owns the tote bag, the bookmark and the reading light.
joke_a: The Do Not Sell My Books at My Funeral socks play on a reader's last wish, said deadpan: whatever else happens, the books stay in the family. Graphic Tees Co. prints it on the leg as an engraved book stack with a candle and lilies, so the line reads from across a room.
source: Do Not Sell My Books crewneck
